decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the feed for actual backpacks, filtering out the many non-backpack accessories like umbrellas, drill bits, and patches. My consideration set included the Gelindo Hydration Backpack (prod_backpacks_078) due to its high ratings and high volume of reviews, the Granite Gear Virga 2 (prod_backpacks_041) for its ultralight capacity, the USWE Hajker (prod_backpacks_125) as a premium technical option, the Dakine Crystal Pack (prod_backpacks_155) for style, and the GZ XINXING (prod_backpacks_167) as a budget-friendly tactical sling option. I ultimately chose the Gelindo 18L Hydration Backpack because it offers excellent value at $31.49 with a 4.7-star rating from over 1,500 users, indicating high reliability and satisfaction for a day-hiking pack compared to the Granite Gear, which had multiple reports of strap failures.
